nodes.name: Gir Online Permit
nodes.description: This service allows online booking of permits for visiting Gir Jungle Safari, GIZ Devalia Safari, Ambardi Safari Park, and Girnar Nature Safari.

sources.evidence: The 'e-Permit' is for a visit to 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' only.
Entry will not be permitted for the safari without original photo identity proof.
During the reporting time, the presence of each person is compulsory.

One 'e-Permit' allows entry of a maximum of 6 adults + 1 child* (3-12 years) to visit 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' within the selected time slot on a particular route only.
For Gir Jungle Safari and Girnar Nature Safari, one person can get only one 'e-Permit' per slot per day.
'GIZ Devalia Safari Park' remain closed every Wednesday.
The e-permit doesn't includes the Guide and Safari vehicle charge,which must be paid separatley to respective Guides and Safari vehicle owners.
The Forest Department's concerned authorities reserve the full rights to change the time slot timings as per the weather/seasonal conditions or due to sudden, unavoidable circumstances.

'Gir Jungle Trail' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' can be booked only through the online booking system, and 'GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari can be booked online as well as current booking if the permits are available.
For Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari, online booking opens three months before the date. It closes down two hours before the date.

Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari visitors are requested to arrive at the respective reception centres (boarding point) 30 minutes before the scheduled time mentioned in the e-Permit.
If the late reporting at the boarding point, e-Permit will get cancelled, and no refund can be claimed.

nodes.name: electrical contractor license
nodes.description: A person can obtain an electrical contractor license if they have an electrical supervisor permit or employ someone with such a permit.

sources.evidence:
A person
A. Who has worked on wiring and electrical installation works under direct supervision of a competency certificate holder or a qualified electrical engineer for a total period of one year.

B. Who has gained six months practical experience after completion of the wireman apprentice course at any recognized technical institute and also passed by the examination held by the Technical Examination Board(TEB).
C. Who has completed one year’s course of electrician or radio mechanic or wireman motor rewinding conducted by the director of cottage industries.
D. Who has completed one year’s course of electrician conducted by the prototype development and training center at Rajkot.
E. Who has completed six months course of motor winding conducted by TEB.

A person who
A. Have passed the examination of the wireman &
B. have total four years of practical experience under direct supervision of a competency certificate holder or qualified electrical engineer out of which minimum two years’ experience must be gained after passing the wireman examination.

or
three and half years practical experience, if such candidate has completed electrician course at recognized technical institute and has passed the examination held by TEB, out of which minimum one and half year’s practical experience must be after passing wireman examination.
The supervisor / wireman exam is conducted by the licensing board twice in a year, one in the month of May and second in the month of November.
For the examination in May, forms are received by this office in the month of February
and for the examination in the month of November, the forms are received by this office in the month of August.
Any person who has electrical supervisor permit or a person who has employed such person can get electrical contractor license.

A person
A. Who has worked on wiring and electrical installation works under direct supervision of a competency certificate holder or a qualified electrical engineer for a total period of one year.

The Solid Waste Management Rules require you to keep your dry and wet waste in separate bags or containers. These should be handed over to the collection agent of the Corporation to be deposited in the containers of the Corporation nearest your house (white for dry waste and green for wet waste).

How to Obtain new building development permission Form vmc? Ans : Open the website of corporation . www.vmc.gov.in , also approach the lissence holder architects, engineer, structural engineer registered with corporation. The list of registered architect engineer & structural engineers available on website.

How much time take for building permission? Ans : According to the T.P. Act 1976 within 90 days permission is granted in accordance to the GDCR( Genaral Devlopment Control Regulation) GDCR is available on website of corporation.

Within how much time Construction Should be Started ? Ans : According to T.P. Act 1976 person who get the permission is valid for one year However it is renewed for further 3 Years. What is the validity period of the permission according to the provision of T.P Act 1+3 year is validity period of the permission then permission is lapsed.

How to get Renewal the Permission. Ans : If it is within the time period in accordance of the act application made with copy of permission letter and copy of approved map. In the Town Planning department of Vadodara Municipal Corporation.

How to Submit a completion notice to the Vadodara Municipal Corporation Ans : At the end of the construction, the building company must notify the VMC about the completion of construction by submitting a completion report in Form No. 7 along with a copy of the plans, structural drawings, photos of building & RWH with Xerox copy of house tax to initiate the final inspection and permit process. પ્રમાણપત્ર આપવામાં સામાન્ય રીતે લાગતો સમય એકમનો સંપૂર્ણ જવાબ વિગતવાર દસ્તાવેજી આધારો સહિત મળ્યાબાદ દિન-૩૦ માં કાર્યવાહી કરી,ખાતાના વડાની મંજૂરી મેળવી પ્રમાણપત્ર આપવામાં આવે છે.
